description: General teacher-editable starter Profile for curating selected work, optional supporting evidence, reflection, and review requirements for a bounded showcase audience.

family.description: Vitrine-owned general starter family for explicitly curated showcase presentation.
family.label: Starter Showcase Portfolio

label: Starter Showcase Portfolio

requirements.statement: The Featured Work section must contain one to three explicitly curated work items.
requirements.title: Featured work

requirements.statement: The student provides reflection connected to the exact curated showcase work.
requirements.title: Student showcase reflection

requirements.statement: Review the exact bounded showcase presentation for privacy concerns before outward-facing use.
requirements.title: Privacy review

requirements.statement: Review rights and reuse concerns for the exact curated showcase material before outward-facing use.
requirements.title: Rights review

requirements.statement: Review accessibility treatment for the bounded showcase presentation.
requirements.title: Accessibility treatment

requirements.statement: When collaborative work is curated, review attribution, collaborator treatment, and minimum-necessary presentation explicitly.
requirements.title: Collaborative-work treatment

requirements.statement: A teacher or authorized curator approves the exact curated showcase before outward-facing presentation.
requirements.title: Final curator approval

audience_rules.purpose: Bounded external-review presentation policy for explicitly curated showcase material. Profile audience policy is not disclosure authorization or permission to publish.

known_limitations: This starter does not determine which work is portfolio-worthy.
This starter does not grant permission to disclose student work.
Privacy, rights, accessibility, and collaborator review remain explicit human or policy decisions.
This starter is general Vitrine guidance, not school, district, state, regulatory, grading, or proficiency policy.
revision.label: Starter Showcase Portfolio

sections.label: Featured Work
sections.purpose: Explicitly curated work selected for the showcase. Featured means curated into this section; Vitrine does not rank or identify best work.

sections.label: Supporting Evidence
sections.purpose: Optional explicitly curated assessment or feedback evidence that provides context without equating a score or rating with the featured work itself.

sections.label: Showcase Reflection
sections.purpose: Student-authored context, choices, process, learning, or significance connected to the exact curated work. The Profile does not infer best work, mastery, proficiency, growth, or portfolio worthiness.
